theme.postHook: for v in gtk-3.0 gtk-4.0; do f="$HOME/.config/$v/gtk.css"; grep -q macos-buttons "$f" || echo '@import "macos-buttons.css";' >> "$f"; done; "$HOME/.local/bin/rice-term-colors"; q="$HOME/.config/qtengine/config.json"; jq '.theme.font={family:"Inter",size:9,weight:-1} | .theme.fontFixed={family:"Monospace",size:9,weight:-1}' "$q" > "$q.tmp" && mv "$q.tmp" "$q"
